consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance at Winterland on October 20, 1978, was solid but not the standout of the five-night run. While some songs like 'Tennessee Jed' and 'Dancin' in the Streets' received praise, the overall energy was perceived as lower compared to other shows in the series.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 19 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While there were notable highlights, many fans felt the show lacked the high energy and consistency of other performances in the run.
